description: Return everything brain knows ABOUT a source (not its facts): the operator-declared identity (type, authLevel — authority in conflict resolution), the learned per-domain agreement rates (domain = predicate; null domain = the global blended rate; rates need >=8 samples before the resolver trusts them over the neutral 0.5), and the reputation-over-time history. sourceKey is `vertical:recorder` (recorder falls back to `_`) — the same key facts carry in trustSnapshot.sourceKey. Shows how much weight a fact whose trustSnapshot looks surprising deserves.
name: get_source_reputation
title: Inspect the reputation of a fact source
